arguments.sql:
SELECT
    ym.Date,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_records,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ym.Consumption IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_consumption,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ym.Consumption = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_consumption,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ym.Consumption < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_consumption,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(ym.Consumption) = 'text' THEN 1 END) AS text_consumption,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unmatched_customers
FROM main.yearmonth AS ym
LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201312'
GROUP BY ym.Date
ORDER BY ym.Date

WITH customer_months AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           COUNT(*) AS recorded_months,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN ym.Consumption > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_months
    FROM main.yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT c.Currency,
       COUNT(*) AS registered_customers,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN m.recorded_months = 11 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_all_months_recorded,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN m.positive_months = 11 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_all_months_positive
FROM main.customers AS c
LEFT JOIN customer_months AS m ON m.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Currency

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID
    FROM main.yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311'
      AND ym.Consumption > 0
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 11
)
SELECT c.Currency, COUNT(q.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM main.customers AS c
LEFT JOIN qualifying_customers AS q ON q.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Currency
